audit_stage: Stage 3 — Verify Walk-Forward Validation and Embargo

horizons_audited.assessment: With embargo=1, the last training sample outcome is realized at t_end + 1 (the embargo session) and does not reach val_start (t_end + 2).
With embargo=3, the last training sample outcome is realized at t_end + 3 (the final embargo session) and does not reach val_start (t_end + 4).
With embargo=5, the last training sample outcome is realized at t_end + 5 (the final embargo session) and does not reach val_start (t_end + 6).

critical_implementation_risk.finding: app/training/walk_forward.py hardcodes a default embargo_sessions: int = 1. If multi-horizon targets (h=3 or h=5) are evaluated without explicitly overriding embargo_sessions=h, the training outcome will bleed 2 to 4 sessions into the validation window, causing lookahead label leakage.
critical_implementation_risk.remediation: Refactor generate_walk_forward_splits or create a baseline validation wrapper that dynamically enforces embargo_sessions >= horizon_sessions.

identical_validation_dates_assessment.assessment: In app/training/walk_forward.py#evaluate_walk_forward_models, all baseline classifiers (MajorityClass, Random) and candidate models (XGBoost, LightGBM) iterate over the exact same fold.X_val and fold.y_val instances. Validation dates and sample indices are 100% identical across all compared models.
